Jb?d6_:8AM.AcSqDFmoN.text:
if you're confused i'll try to explain how the four digit code works,
basically, each digit corresponds to a side

the first digit is for the top
the second digit is for the right
the third digit is for the bottom
and the fourth digit is for the left

if the digit is 1, then there should not be a wall on that side
if it is a 0, there should be a wall on that side

so, for example 1001 would mean it is open on the top and left but closed on the bottom and right

also if you want to change the wall style for an biome/location then open the list named "wall styles" and the list named "all area names" and then look at the number of the name of the biome/location in the list "all area names" then go to that same number item in "wall styles" and change that to whatever

example:
say you are making wall style 5 and want this wall style to be for the Underground Plains, you first open up the list named "all area names" and see that the Underground Plains is item #4, then go and change item #4 in wall style to be 5 since you want Underground Plains to have wall style 5

this should help making wall new styles
